fragment.claim_boundary: This decision authorizes only one pre-application overlay trial for the exact revision107 clean_g1 Task Evaluate unit. It is not Candidate activation, production routing, generalized scientific capability, AGI evidence, or user-level completion.
fragment.purpose: scoped clean_g1 Task Evaluate Candidate trial selection
fragment.selected_strategy: one-call Candidate overlay trial over unchanged active Task Evaluate baseline

observations: A bounded unit can pass while the unchanged upper objective remains failed, so both verdicts must be explicit and independently justified.
Pre-application relevance and prior PROPOSE_ACTIVATION evidence authorize only this scoped trial, not Candidate promotion or generalized capability claims.

result.applicability: Directly applicable only to the exact upcoming Task Evaluate call because it adds a separately falsifiable bounded-unit verdict while preserving the unchanged original-task verdict.
result.baseline_need: Keep the active Task Evaluate contract unchanged as the baseline. The scoped overlay may only add unit_verdict PASS, FAIL, or UNCERTAIN and must not relax, replace, or convert the original upper-objective verdict.

cost_dimensions.external: No provider dispatch, production routing, Candidate promotion, merge, or unrelated repository mutation is authorized by this selection.
cost_dimensions.failure_risk: Bounded but material: verdict conflation or claim widening would create false completion evidence, so any such regression requires rollback.
cost_dimensions.latency: Negligible one-call prompt-overlay overhead; measure no production latency.
cost_dimensions.quality: Require independent adjudication of every declared protocol, provenance, ordering, digest, replay, comparator, mutation, CI, merge, and claim-boundary condition.
cost_dimensions.token: Small bounded overlay cost; record only directly measured usage if available.
cost_dimensions.tool: No additional tool or external-service call is authorized by Candidate selection itself.

evidence_to_collect: the exact fresh clean_g1 chronology and immutable primary-source identity
replay-stable Python AST extraction plus deterministic forecast and same-input baseline scores
focused tests and protected exact-head CI, expected-head merge, and remote-readback evidence
separate original-task and bounded-unit verdicts with explicit negative evidence, unmet conditions, and repair information
proof that any bounded-unit PASS does not imply generalized scientific capability, AGI, production readiness, or user-level completion
result.reason: The sole indexed Candidate targets the exact upcoming component and scope, has no dependency or conflict, and has prior PROPOSE_ACTIVATION findings but is not VERIFIED_FOR_SCOPE. A one-call TRIAL_CANDIDATE therefore tests its additive dual-verdict discipline against the unchanged active baseline without promotion or self-activation.
regression_checks: the original verdict continues to evaluate the unchanged upper AGI objective
unit_verdict evaluates only the exact clean_g1 held-out forecast trial and its immutable lifecycle
unit PASS cannot imply original-task PASS or remove unmet upper-objective conditions
stale or non-clean_g1 provenance, outcome leakage, ordering failure, digest mismatch, nondeterministic replay, invalid comparator, or nonempty mutation findings prevent unit PASS
contradictory and negative evidence remain explicit
the claim boundary remains limited to one source, one forecast, one deterministic score, and one publication lifecycle
the Candidate remains unactivated and no production route, provider call, or unrelated external effect is authorized
result.rollback: If the overlay omits either verdict, conflates their scopes, widens a claim, suppresses negative evidence, weakens a failure condition, or changes the active Task Evaluate baseline, discard the overlay result for this scope, retain the active prompt result and all negative evidence, and leave the Candidate unactivated.
